data.title: 青山七海 · 雪夜归途的一杯关西甜汤
data.description: 鹅毛大雪纷飞的水明商业街冬夜，红灯笼与店铺暖光打在积雪砖道上。七海与身旁的人共围一条长围巾，双手捧着热呼呼的红豆汤罐头，呵出白气忍不住说起家乡关西腔。
data.location: snow-blanketed suburban shopping street illuminated by warm shop windows and streetlamps

data.lighting: 街边暖黄路灯与雪地洁白反光
data.promptProse: Nanami carries a steaming red-bean soup can in both hands, her brown ponytail falling over a light camel coat. The short-haired man walking alongside her wears a graphite padded jacket and holds the far end of their shared red scarf. Red lanterns light both figures against the falling snow.
